transcript.text: dyson keeps pulsin on n off like its stutterin, wont stay on proper. batt is full. pls help

Switch it off and unplug it (or take the battery off) first. This stuttering behavior usually indicates a blockage in the air path or a failing battery that cannot sustain power. You should check for clogs in the hose and wand, then try resetting the vacuum by turning it off and on again. This sounds like normal behaviour rather than a fault: A cordless vacuum pulsing on and off is its warning that airflow is blocked or the filter needs washing (or the battery is not making contact); it is protection, not a fault in itself. It would be worth a closer look if it still pulses with clear airways, a clean dry filter and a charged battery. Detach the wand and floorhead and look through each part, and check the bin inlet — a coin dropped through the wand should fall straight out. Did you find a blockage and clear it, is there one you can't shift, is a hose split, or was it all clear?
[Helpful to see: image "Poor suction — what to check first" — A vacuum that pulses or cuts out after running is usually a full bin, a dirty filter or a blockage starving the airflow — check and clear those before suspecting battery, charger or motor. Switch off and unplug first. Typical layout — your model may differ.]
found a big clump of hair and cat litter stuck at the bottom of the wand where the head goes on, pulled it out. its a v8 animal btw. no burning smell or heat or anything
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
